what_this_is: how much of the MetaTox column's recall at each budget is the method's own ordering and how much is the order its supplier's file happened to have
what_was_permuted: only within classes the method itself ties: one class per distinct Pa and one for the whole unscored block, which PASS leaves unranked because it writes a spectrum only above its own threshold. Every permutation is therefore an equally faithful reading of what MetaTox returned; none crosses a difference the method expressed
